items.title: I Let CodeSpeak Take Over My Repository

items.title: You can make an app for that
items.description: The tyranny of software is almost over. Since the first computer programmers wrote the first computer programs, we, the users of that software, have been forced to live in the worlds those programs create. The features are the features. The design is the design. Want something else, something better
items.tldr: ソフトウェアの支配が終わりを迎えつつあり、ユーザーはプログラムが作り出す世界に縛られることなく、自分の望む機能やデザインを持つアプリを作成できるようになる。

items.title: Who decides what AI tells you? Campbell Brown, once Meta’s news chief, has thoughts
items.description: "The conversation is sort of happening in Silicon Valley around one thing, and a totally different conversation is happening among consumers."

items.title: Clio’s $500M milestone arrives just as Anthropic ups the ante
items.description: Legal tech startups, including Clio, which just hit $500 million in ARR, are seeing massive customer adoption.

items.title: Microsoft’s Edge Copilot update uses AI to pull information from across your tabs
items.description: Microsoft Edge is adding a new feature that will allow its Copilot AI chatbot to gather information from all of your open tabs. items.tldr: Microsoft Edgeの新機能により、Copilot AIチャットボットが開いているすべてのタブから情報を収集できるようになります。ユーザーはタブ内の内容について質問したり、製品を比較したり、開いている記事を要約したりすることが可能です。

items.title: Notion just turned its workspace into a hub for AI agents
items.description: Notion’s new developer platform lets teams connect AI agents, external data sources, and custom code directly into their workspace as the company pushes deeper into agentic productivity software.

items.title: Musk’s xAI is running nearly 50 gas turbines unchecked at its Mississippi data center
items.description: Gas turbines at xAI's Colossus 2 data center have drawn a lawsuit over the company's use of "mobile" gas turbines as power plants.

items.title: I Built the Same B2B Document Extractor Twice: Rules vs. LLM

items.tldr: AMDは、FSR 4.1をRDNA 3 GPUに7月に、RDNA 2 GPUには2027年初頭に対応させることを発表し、これにより多くのゲーマーがパフォーマンスを犠牲にすることなく優れたビジュアルを楽しめるようになる。

items.title: CPUID Adds AMD Gorgon Halo Support To CPU-Z; Intel Wildcat Lake And Bartlett Lake Also Receive Support
items.description: Several newly released and upcoming hardware are now added to the CPU-Z database, allowing better reporting in the software. CPUID Brings AMD Gorgon Halo, Ryzen PRO 9000 Series, Gorgon Point 2/3, Intel Bartlett Lake and Wildcat Lake Support to CPU-Z Software After dealing with the malware, CPUID is
items.tldr: CPUIDがCPU-ZソフトウェアにAMD Gorgon Halo、Ryzen PRO 9000シリーズ、Gorgon Point 2/3、Intel Bartlett LakeおよびWildcat Lakeのサポートを追加し、ハードウェアの報告が改善されました。

items.title: Sea You in the Cloud: ‘Subnautica 2’ Early Access Dives Onto GeForce NOW
items.description: Dive masks on — Subnautica 2 is making a splash on GeForce NOW day-and-date with launch, so members can plunge into the title’s brand-new alien ocean from almost any device. It leads 11 new games joining the cloud this week. A limited-time HITMAN World of Assassination reward event brings signature
items.tldr: 「Subnautica 2」がGeForce NOWで早期アクセスとしてリリースされ、ほぼすべてのデバイスから新しいエイリアンの海に潜ることができるようになります。今週は他に11本の新ゲームもクラウドに追加され、HITMAN World of Assassinationの限定報酬イベントも開催中です。

items.title: Alienware's budget gaming laptop starts at $1,299 — Last-gen parts and a plastic shell bring the premium brand into the mainstream
items.description: The Alienware 15 Gaming Laptop uses last-gen Intel, AMD, and Nvidia components to bring the brand to a wider audience and replace Dell's former G-Series notebooks.
items.tldr: Alienwareの新しい15インチゲーミングノートパソコンは、旧世代のIntel、AMD、Nvidiaコンポーネントを使用し、1299ドルからの価格でプレミアムブランドを一般向けに展開しています。

items.title: NVIDIA Passes Another $300 Hit to RTX 5090 Board Partners as VRAM Shortage Pushes Flagship GPU Toward $5,000
items.description: Once again, we may see the RTX 5090 prices jumping even further as NVIDIA has reportedly hiked the GPU price due to VRAM shortages. GeForce RTX 5090 and RTX 5090 V2 Reportedly Seeing Another Price Hike Due to VRAM Procurement Costs NVIDIA is once again set to increase the prices of its flagship Blac
items.tldr: NVIDIAはVRAM不足により、RTX 5090の価格をさらに300ドル引き上げると報じられており、これにより同GPUの価格が5,000ドルに迫る可能性があります。

items.title: V-Color’s New OC RDIMM Smashes The 9600 MT/s Barrier On Intel’s W890 Platform, While Sipping Just 1.1V At 8000 MT/s
items.description: The new server memory can achieve a staggering 9600 MT/s on Intel W890 and can operate at just 1.1V while running at 8000 MT/s. V-Color Unveils World's First RDIMM Memory to Hit 9600 MT/s on ASUS PRO WS W890E; Available in Up To 256 GB Capacity Per Module Popular memory maker, V-Color, has expanded
items.tldr: V-Colorは、IntelのW890プラットフォーム上で9600 MT/sを達成する世界初のOC RDIMMメモリを発表し、8000 MT/sで動作する際にはわずか1.1Vの電圧で動作します。

items.title: Fully-functional RTX 3070 16GB gets frankensteined into existence by harvesting dead PCBs and RX 6800 XT's VRAM chips — doubles frame rate in games like Spider Man 2 at 4K and includes switch for 8GB mode
items.description: A tech enthusiast has combined an Nvidia GeForce RTX 3070 (8GB) with defective memory and an AMD Radeon RX 6900 XT (16GB) with a damaged GPU to make a working RTX 3070 with 16GB of VRAM.
items.tldr: 技術愛好者が、故障したPC基板とAMD Radeon RX 6900 XTのVRAMチップを利用して、16GBのVRAMを搭載した完全機能のRTX 3070を作成し、4Kでのゲームプレイ時にフレームレートを倍増させることに成功しました。

items.title: Leading-edge foundry roadmaps for TSMC, Intel and Samsung — outlining the path to 1.4nm nodes and beyond
items.description: All three leading foundries have now entered the 2nm era, but their paths from now on diverge sharply: TSMC bets on predictability, Intel wagers on aggressive architectural shifts, and Samsung's primary focus is on improving yields.
items.tldr: TL;DR: TSMC、Intel、Samsungの3大ファウンドリは2nm時代に突入したが、TSMCは予測可能性、Intelは攻撃的なアーキテクチャの変革、Samsungは歩留まりの改善に注力することで、それぞれ異なる進路を辿る。

items.title: 70% of Americans oppose data centers near their homes, now less popular than nuclear power plants — opposition towards nearby AI infrastructure heating up as tech companies ramp up projects to acquire more compute
items.description: A new survey revealed that 7 out of 10 Americans are against data center developers building projects within the vicinity of their homes. This is a massive increase from the late 2025 survey which showed that 47% of people are against AI data centers near their homes.
items.tldr: 最新の調査によると、70%のアメリカ人が自宅近くにデータセンターを建設することに反対しており、これは2025年末の調査から大幅に増加した結果です。

items.title: $1,149 for this 1440p gaming rig is an absolute steal in this Limited-time Woot sale — get an RTX 5060 Ti GPU inside Lenovo's Legion Tower 5i, now $410 off
items.description: An RTX 5060 Ti-powered gaming rig for only $1149 from Lenovo. The Legion Tower 5i is discounted by $410 in today's limited-time Woot sale.
items.tldr: LenovoのLegion Tower 5iが、RTX 5060 Tiを搭載し、限定のWootセールで$410オフの$1,149で販売中です。

items.title: Apple’s Quad-Curved Display Design For The iPhone 20 Has A Major Flaw, But The Company Isn’t Going To Fix It Next Year
items.description: The iPhone 20’s quad-curved display will be Apple’s most challenging task yet, but the company’s trillion-dollar status wasn’t achieved by taking a backseat when facing adversity. However, that doesn’t mean the California-based giant won’t face problems with this design, as a new report highlights a
items.tldr: AppleのiPhone 20の四隅が曲がったディスプレイデザインには重大な欠陥があるが、同社は来年この問題を修正するつもりはないという報告がある。

items.title: Final Fantasy VII Remake Part 3 Will Continue Zack’s Story, But Preservation of Original’s Core Suggest His Fate Won’t Change
items.description: One of the biggest changes introduced in Final Fantasy VII Remake and its sequel, Rebirth, is Zack Fair's role. While he only appeared briefly in the original game, his role has been vastly expanded in the remake trilogy, becoming a playable character in Rebirth with his own individual story segment
items.tldr: TL;DR: 「ファイナルファンタジーVII リメイク」パート3ではザック・フェアの物語が続くが、オリジナルの核心を保つため彼の運命は変わらない可能性が高い。

items.title: AMD reaches 46% of server x86 CPU revenue — Intel still controls 70% of the consumer PC market share
items.description: AMD now commands 38.1% of total x86 CPU revenue share, skyrockets past 46.2% x86 server CPU market share, according to Mercury Research.
items.tldr: AMDはx86 CPU全体の収益シェアで38.1%、x86サーバーCPU市場では46.2%を超えるシェアを獲得している一方で、Intelは依然としてコンシューマPC市場で70%のシェアを保持している。

items.title: $499 case turns your PC into a liquid cooling masterpiece for your wall — Portal Advanced comes with an integrated distribution plate and reservoir to start of your build
items.description: Singularity Computers has announced the Portal Advanced, an open wall-mounted display case with liquid-cooling support, starting at $499.
items.tldr: Singularity Computersが発表したPortal Advancedは、液体冷却をサポートするオープンな壁掛けPCケースで、価格は499ドルから。

items.title: Bitcoin trader recovers $400,000 using Claude AI after getting 'stoned' and losing wallet password 11 years ago — bot tried 3.5 trillion passwords before decrypting an old wallet backup
items.description: An X user shared how they were able to recover the password on their old cryptocurrency wallet using Claude and some luck.
items.tldr: ビットコイントレーダーが、11年前に失ったウォレットのパスワードをClaude AIを使って復元し、40万ドルを取り戻した。AIは35兆通りのパスワードを試行して古いバックアップを解読した。

items.title: NVIDIA To Claw Back Lost China Market With H200 Approval After US Curbs Crushed Its 95% Share Down To Nothing
items.description: The US Government has approved NVIDIA's GPU sales to China, allowing 10 Chinese firms to access the Hopper H200 GPU. Chinese AI Firms Can Now Access NVIDIA's Hopper H200 GPUs, But Only Up To 75,000 Units Each NVIDIA CEO made a last-minute change in his plans to tag alongside US President, Donald J T
items.tldr: NVIDIAは、米国政府からの承認を受けて、中国市場でのHopper H200 GPUの販売を再開し、10社の中国企業が各75,000ユニットまでアクセスできるようになった。

items.title: Louis Rossmann taunts Bambu Lab by hosting banned 3D Printer firmware fork, dares $1 billion company to sue him — more creators pledge support and boycotts, Snapmaker donates equipment to embattled developer
items.description: Louis Rossmann posted yet another YouTube video taunting the 3D printing juggernaut into taking legal action. In the video, he stated the contentious fork of OrcaSlicer-BambuLab was now hosted on his own FULU (Freedom from Unethical Limitations) Foundation GitHub.
items.tldr: Louis Rossmannが、3Dプリンター企業Bambu Labを挑発し、禁止されたOrcaSlicer-BambuLabのフォークを自らのFULU Foundation GitHubでホストしていることを報告し、法的措置を取るよう促しています。これに対し、他のクリエイターたちが支持を表明し、ボイコットを行い、Snapmakerが困難な状況にある開発者に機器を寄付しました。

items.title: This $329.99 32GB Corsair Pro Overclocking kit is the cheapest DDR5 RAM on sale right now — ultra-fast 6400 MT/s memory upgrade for your gaming PC comes with $70 price drop that makes it $40 cheaper than its next-best rival
items.description: You can grab 32GB of fast DDR5-6400 Corsair Pro Overclocking RAM for just $329.99 right now. That's a $70 price drop compared to its list price and one that makes it the cheapest option on sale, turning it into an unmissable deal for a gaming PC upgrade.
items.tldr: 現在、32GBのDDR5-6400 Corsair Pro Overclocking RAMが329.99ドルで販売中で、70ドルの値下げにより最安値となっています。これはゲーミングPCのアップグレードに最適なお得なオプションです。

items.title: Chinese Display Makers Are Pushing Their Production Schedule To Timely Equip MacBook Pro Rivals With Next-Generation OLEDs To Take On Samsung
items.description: Apple has been reported to finally ditch mini-LED technology and transition to tandem OLED with its next 14-inch and 16-inch MacBook Pro lineup, with Samsung helping its client make the switch, as it’s currently the company’s sole supplier of these high-end panels. However, Chinese manufacturer BOE
items.tldr: 中国のディスプレイメーカーが、次世代OLEDを搭載したMacBook Proの競合製品をタイムリーに供給するために生産スケジュールを前倒ししている。Appleはmini-LED技術を廃止し、Samsungの協力を得て新しいOLED技術に移行する。

items.title: ARC Raiders Smashes Past 16 Million Sales in Six Months as Embark Quietly Greenlights Two New Games
items.description: NEXON's Q1 2026 earnings report reveals that the third-person extraction shooter game ARC Raiders has now broken the impressive milestone of 16 million units sold in around six and a half months. The game sold 4.6 million units in Q1 alone, reaching 15.5 million by the end of Q1 before crossing 16M
items.tldr: ARC Raidersが発売から約6か月で1600万本の販売を達成し、NEXONのQ1 2026の報告によると、Q1だけで460万本を売り上げたことが明らかになった。

items.title: AI Drives Cybersecurity Investments, Widening 'Valley of Death'
items.description: In a role reversal, investment dollars in AI security startups exceeded the value of AI acquisitions in 1Q26 by more than $1 billion, a rare occurrence.
items.tldr: AIセキュリティスタートアップへの投資額が2026年第1四半期にAI買収額を10億ドル以上上回り、サイバーセキュリティ分野での投資が急増している。

items.title: KongTuke hackers now use Microsoft Teams for corporate breaches
items.description: Initial access broker KongTuke has moved to Microsoft Teams for social engineering attacks, taking as little as five minutes to gain persistent access to corporate networks. [...]
items.tldr: KongTukeハッカーは、企業侵害のためのソーシャルエンジニアリング攻撃にMicrosoft Teamsを利用し、わずか5分で企業ネットワークへの持続的なアクセスを得ることができるようになった。

items.title: Foxconn Attack Highlights Manufacturing's Cyber Crisis
items.description: A Nitrogen ransomware attack on Foxconn's North American facilities is one of 600 hits on manufacturers this year, as gangs increasingly target the sector for its low tolerance for downtime.
items.tldr: Foxconnの北米施設に対するNitrogenランサムウェア攻撃は、今年製造業に対する600件の攻撃の一つであり、ギャングがダウンタイムに対する耐性が低いこのセクターを狙う傾向が強まっていることを示しています。

items.title: PraisonAI CVE-2026-44338 Auth Bypass Targeted Within Hours of Disclosure
items.description: Threat actors have been observed attempting to exploit a recently disclosed security vulnerability in PraisonAI, an open-source multi-agent orchestration framework, within four hours of public disclosure. The vulnerability in question is CVE-2026-44338 (CVSS score: 7.3), a case of missing authentica
items.tldr: PraisonAIのオープンソースマルチエージェントオーケストレーションフレームワークにおけるCVE-2026-44338の脆弱性が公開からわずか4時間で悪用される試みが確認されました。

items.title: How AI Hallucinations Are Creating Real Security Risks
items.description: AI hallucinations are introducing serious security risks into critical infrastructure decision-making by exploiting human trust through highly confident yet incorrect outputs. When an AI model lacks certainty, it doesn’t have a mechanism to recognize that. Instead, it generates the most probable res
items.tldr: AIの幻覚は、信頼を利用して誤った出力を生成し、重要なインフラの意思決定に深刻なセキュリティリスクをもたらしている。AIモデルは不確実性を認識する仕組みを持たず、最も可能性の高い結果を出力する。

items.title: How Dangerous Is Anthropic’s Mythos AI?
items.description: Last month, Anthropic made a remarkable announcement about its new model, Claude Mythos Preview: it was so good at finding security vulnerabilities in software that the company would not release it to the general public. Instead, it would only be available to a select group of companies to scan and
items.tldr: Anthropicの新モデルClaude Mythos Previewは、ソフトウェアのセキュリティ脆弱性を発見する能力が非常に高いため、一般公開されず、特定の企業のみが利用できることになった。

items.title: Dell confirms its SupportAssist software causes Windows BSOD crashes
items.description: Dell confirmed that its SupportAssist software is causing blue-screen crashes on some Windows systems following a wave of user reports about random reboots affecting Dell devices since Friday. [...]
items.tldr: Dellは、SupportAssistソフトウェアが一部のWindowsシステムでブルースクリーンのクラッシュを引き起こしていることを確認しました。

items.title: Windows Zero-Days Expose BitLocker Bypasses And CTFMON Privilege Escalation
items.description: An anonymous cybersecurity researcher who disclosed three Microsoft Defender vulnerabilities has returned with two more zero-days involving a BitLocker bypass and a privilege escalation impacting Windows Collaborative Translation Framework (CTFMON). The security defects have been codenamed YellowKey
items.tldr: TL;DR: 匿名のサイバーセキュリティ研究者が、BitLockerバイパスとWindows Collaborative Translation Framework (CTFMON)に影響を与える特権昇格を含む2つのゼロデイ脆弱性を公開し、これらは「YellowKey」と名付けられた。

items.title: US charges suspected Dream Market admin arrested in Germany
items.description: The alleged main administrator of Dream Market Incognito Market, one of the largest dark web marketplaces before its shutdown, has been indicted in the United States on money laundering charges. [...]
items.tldr: 米国は、閉鎖前の最大のダークウェブマーケットプレイスの一つであるDream Marketの主要管理者を、マネーロンダリングの罪で起訴した。

items.title: New Fragnesia Linux flaw lets attackers gain root privileges
items.description: Linux distros are rolling out patches for a new high-severity kernel privilege escalation vulnerability (known as Fragnasia and tracked as CVE-2026-46300) that allows attackers to run malicious code as root. [...]
items.tldr: 新たな高危険度のLinuxカーネル特権昇格脆弱性「Fragnasia」（CVE-2026-46300）が発見され、攻撃者がroot権限で悪意のあるコードを実行できるため、各Linuxディストリビューションがパッチを展開しています。

items.title: New Fragnesia Linux Kernel LPE Grants Root Access via Page Cache Corruption
items.description: Details have emerged about a new variant of the recent Dirty Frag Linux local privilege escalation (LPE) vulnerability that allows local attackers to gain root access, making it the third such bug to be identified in the kernel within a span of two weeks. Codenamed Fragnesia, the security vulnerabil
items.tldr: 新たに発見されたFragnesiaというLinuxカーネルのローカル特権昇格（LPE）脆弱性により、攻撃者はページキャッシュの破損を利用してルートアクセスを取得できる。この脆弱性は、過去2週間で特定された3つ目のカーネルバグとなる。

items.title: 18-Year-Old NGINX Rewrite Module Flaw Enables Unauthenticated RCE
items.description: Cybersecurity researchers have disclosed multiple security vulnerabilities impacting NGINX Plus and NGINX Open, including a critical flaw that remained undetected for 18 years. The vulnerability, discovered by depthfirst, is a heap buffer overflow issue impacting ngx_http_rewrite_module (CVE-2026-42
items.tldr: 18年間未発見だったNGINXのリライトモジュールに関する脆弱性（CVE-2026-42）が、認証なしでリモートコード実行（RCE）を可能にすることが明らかになった。

items.title: West Pharmaceutical says hackers stole data, encrypted systems
items.description: West Pharmaceutical Services disclosed that it was the target of a cyberattack that resulted in data exfiltration and system encryption. [...]
items.tldr: West Pharmaceutical Servicesはサイバー攻撃を受け、データが流出しシステムが暗号化されたことを発表しました。

items.title: Iranian hackers targeted major South Korean electronics maker
items.description: The Iran-linked hacking group MuddyWater (a.k.a. Seedworm, Static Kitten) launched a broad cyber-espionage campaign targeting at least nine high-profile organizations across multiple sectors and countries. [...]
items.tldr: イランに関連するハッキンググループMuddyWaterが、少なくとも9つの著名な組織を標的にした広範なサイバー諜報キャンペーンを展開しました。

items.title: Checkbox Assessments Aren't Fit to Measure to Risk
items.description: Security governance needs to be more than an annual compliance exercise. New companies are emerging to address risk-management gaps in current audit tools.
items.tldr: TL;DR: セキュリティガバナンスは年次コンプライアンスの枠を超える必要があり、新たな企業が現行の監査ツールのリスク管理ギャップに対応しようとしている。

items.title: Attackers Weaponize RubyGems for Data Dead Drops
items.description: Threat actors are publishing RubyGems packages that include scrapers targeting public-facing UK government servers, but with no clear objective.
items.tldr: 攻撃者が目的不明のまま、UK政府の公的サーバーを狙ったスクレイパーを含むRubyGemsパッケージを公開している。

items.title: Tables Turn on 'The Gentlemen' RaaS Gang With Data Leak
items.description: An OPSEC failure provides a window into what helped the ransomware group rise: a generous affiliate model, opportunistic TTPs, and an effective organizational structure.
items.tldr: TL;DR: OPSECの失敗により、RaaSグループ「The Gentlemen」の成功要因であるアフィリエイトモデル、機会主義的TTP、効果的な組織構造が明らかになった。

items.title: New critical Exim mailer flaw allows remote code execution
items.description: A critical vulnerability affecting certain configurations of the Exim open-source mail transfer agent could be exploited by an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. [...]
items.tldr: TL;DR: Eximの特定の設定に影響を与える重大な脆弱性が発見され、認証されていないリモート攻撃者が任意のコードを実行できる可能性があります。

items.title: Dark Reading Celebrates 20 Years as a Leading Authority on Cybersecurity, Highlighting the People, Events, Ideas, and Technologies Shaping the Modern Risk Landscape
items.description: Informa TechTarget's flagship cybersecurity media brand launches a special content series to mark two decades as a trusted source for cybersecurity professionals.
items.tldr: TL;DR: Dark Readingが20周年を迎え、サイバーセキュリティ専門家向けの信頼できる情報源としての地位を祝う特別コンテンツシリーズを開始しました。

items.title: Windows BitLocker zero-day gives access to protected drives, PoC released
items.description: A cybersecurity researcher has published proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits for two unpatched Microsoft Windows vulnerabilities named YellowKey and GreenPlasma, which are a BitLocker bypass and a privilege-escalation flaw. [...]
items.tldr: WindowsのBitLockerをバイパスする脆弱性「YellowKey」と特権昇格の脆弱性「GreenPlasma」に対するPoCが公開され、保護されたドライブへのアクセスが可能になることが報告されています。
